
```jsx
import { CxProgressBar } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxProgressBar from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/progress/CxProgressBar'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **animated** | Use to animate the stripes right to left via CSS3 animations. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **context** | Sets the context context of the component to one of Bootstrap React’s themed colors. | `'primary'` \| `'secondary'` \| `'success'` \| `'danger'` \| `'warning'` \| `'info'` \| `'dark'` \| `'light'` \| `string` | - |
| **value** | The percent to progress the ProgressBar. | `number` \| `undefined` | 0 |
| **variant** | Set the progress bar variant to optional striped. | `'striped'` \| `undefined` | - |
